# ReadSpeaker

> ReadSpeaker turns text into natural-sounding voice for education and enterprise: web accessibility, custom brand voices, and voice AI for your product, in 90+ languages.

This file lists the main English pages of the ReadSpeaker website. Translated pages are published under the language prefixes /ar/, /da/, /de/, /es/, /fi/, /fr/, /it/, /lv/, /nb/, /nl/, /pl/, /pt/, /sv/.
Every page is listed in the [sitemap](https://www.readspeaker.com/sitemap-index.xml).

## Products

- [ReadSpeaker’s Products and Features](https://www.readspeaker.com/products/): Discover all of ReadSpeaker's products and features to understand what ReadSpeaker is used for and how it enhances accessibility for all.
- [Custom Neural Voice: Your Unique Brand Voice - ReadSpeaker VoiceLab](https://www.readspeaker.com/custom-voice/): Exclusive neural text-to-speech voice, engineered by experts and based on contracted human voice talent. Deployed wherever you engage customers.
- [Voice cloning software for brands](https://www.readspeaker.com/voice-cloning-software/): Discover ReadSpeaker’s state-of-the-art AI voice cloning technology that allows us to create natural-sounding text-to-speech voices for your business.
- [IVONA TTS Licensing](https://www.readspeaker.com/ivona-tts-licensing/)
- [ReadSpeaker docReader - Accessible Document Reader for Web](https://www.readspeaker.com/products/docreader/): Make the documents you publish accessible. docReader adds a Listen button to PDFs, Word and PowerPoint, reading them aloud in 40+ languages. WCAG 2.2 AA.
- [Text to Speech Solutions for Learners (Students & Adults)](https://www.readspeaker.com/products/education/): Whether learning at primary school, high school, university or in the workplace, ReadSpeaker's text to speech solution helps make content inclusive, engaging, and accessible.
- [ReadSpeaker speechCloud API - Enterprise Text-to-Speech REST API](https://www.readspeaker.com/products/speechcloud-api/): Text-to-speech REST API: 90 languages, 300 voices, SSML, custom dictionaries, six audio formats. Real-time or batch. ISO/IEC 27001 certified.
- [Embedded Text-to-Speech SDK - On-Device AI Voices](https://www.readspeaker.com/products/speechengine-sdk-embedded/): Add natural AI voices to any device with ReadSpeaker speechEngine SDK Embedded. On-device text-to-speech for ARM, iOS, Android, and Embedded Linux hardware.
- [speechEngine SDK - On-Device TTS for Desktop Apps](https://www.readspeaker.com/products/speechengine-sdk/): On-device text-to-speech SDK for desktop and PC apps. 150+ AI voices, 50+ languages. C/C++ and Java on Windows/Linux, C# on Windows. Runs offline, no network calls.
- [speechMaker Studio: Collaborative Text to Speech for Teams](https://www.readspeaker.com/products/speechmaker-studio/): Create, edit, and manage professional voice content with ReadSpeaker speechMaker Studio, a browser-based, collaborative text-to-speech platform for teams.
- [Create Audio From Text - ReadSpeaker speechMaker](https://www.readspeaker.com/products/speechmaker/): Convert text into downloadable audio files. Produce single files or batches from Excel in MP3, OGG, and WAV. Cloud-based and ISO 27001 certified.
- [ReadSpeaker speechServer MRCP: MRCP server for IVR TTS](https://www.readspeaker.com/products/speechserver-mrcp/): On-premise MRCP server for IVR systems and call centers. IETF MRCPv2 + UniMRCP interoperability. Certified Cisco CVP, Avaya AAEP. 150+ voices, 50+ languages.
- [ReadSpeaker speechServer - On-premise text-to-speech server](https://www.readspeaker.com/products/speechserver/): Self-hosted, network-based text-to-speech server you run on your own Windows Server or Linux. Integrate over TCP/IP, command line, REST, or C, Java, .NET SDKs.
- [ReadSpeaker TextAid - Literacy Support Software for Every Learner](https://www.readspeaker.com/products/textaid/): Help every student read, write, and study with confidence. WCAG 2.2 AA, exam-ready, LMS-integrated. Free trial, no credit card.
- [webReader: Text to Speech for Any Website](https://www.readspeaker.com/products/webreader/): Add a Listen button to your website. webReader reads any page aloud in 90+ languages with real-time highlighting, WCAG 2.2 AA compliant, no rebuild required.

## Sectors and solutions

- [Tailored Text-to-Speech Solutions by Sector](https://www.readspeaker.com/sectors/): Need text to speech tailored to your sector? ReadSpeaker's AI-driven TTS solutions fit seamlessly, enhancing every interaction.
- [Text to Speech for Assistive Technology and AAC](https://www.readspeaker.com/sectors/assistive-technology/): Discover AI-powered text-to-speech for assistive technology and AAC users. Support autism, cerebral palsy, ALS, and more with natural-sounding voices.
- [Automotive Voice AI & In-Car Voice Assistants](https://www.readspeaker.com/sectors/automotive/): Power safer, hands-free driving with Automotive Voice AI. ReadSpeaker TTS enhances in-car voice assistants, infotainment, and branded OEM voices.
- [AI Voice Solutions for Banking & Fintech](https://www.readspeaker.com/sectors/banking/): Enhance your fintech and banking customer experience with secure, customizable AI generated voice solutions. Automate interactions, boost engagement, and ensure compliance with ReadSpeaker.
- [Text to Speech for Contact Centers, IVR & Conversational AI](https://www.readspeaker.com/sectors/conversational-ai/): Enhance customer experience with ReadSpeaker text to speech for contact center and IVR. Secure, flexible, and natural AI voice solutions for every platform
- [AI Voices & Text-to-Speech for Defense](https://www.readspeaker.com/sectors/defense/): Secure, ai-powered text to speech for defense & national security. On-prem, offline, embedded TTS for training, mission systems, and accessibility.
- [Text-to-Speech for Education & eLearning](https://www.readspeaker.com/sectors/education/): Children, students, adults, in the classroom, at home or at the workplace, our text to speech software can help any type of learners.
- [Embedded & On-Device Text-to-Speech Solutions](https://www.readspeaker.com/sectors/embedded/): Embed high-quality, natural-sounding voices into devices, IoT, robotics, and apps. Offline, small footprint TTS with 150+ voices in 50+ languages.
- [Text to Speech for Gaming](https://www.readspeaker.com/sectors/gaming/): Get runtime text to speech for gaming: UI narration, audio descriptions, and dynamic dialogue. Build in your game engine and deploy on all devices.
- [Text to Speech for Healthcare & Pharma](https://www.readspeaker.com/sectors/healthcare/): AI-powered text-to-speech for healthcare and pharmaceuticals. Improve patient engagement, compliance, and accessibility with secure, scalable voices.
- [Text to Speech for Industrial Automation](https://www.readspeaker.com/sectors/industrial-automation/): Text to speech for industrial automation. Voice alerts, operator guidance, and real-time output across embedded and on-premise systems.
- [Text to Speech for News & Media | AI Voice for Newsrooms](https://www.readspeaker.com/sectors/media/): AI-powered text to speech for newsrooms and media organisations. Deliver real-time audio articles, podcasts, and accessible news experiences across every platform.
- [Public Announcement & Emergency Broadcast Systems](https://www.readspeaker.com/sectors/pa-broadcast-systems/): ReadSpeaker text-to-speech solutions for transportation, public announcement and emergency broadcast systems.
- [Inclusive Public Services with Text to Speech](https://www.readspeaker.com/sectors/public-services/): Enhance accessibility in public services with ReadSpeaker's text-to-speech solutions. Deliver inclusive experiences for all users with lifelike, multilingual AI voices.
- [Text-to-Speech Solutions for the Publishing Industry](https://www.readspeaker.com/sectors/publishing/): Transform written content into natural-sounding voices for eBooks, audiobooks, and learning platforms. ReadSpeaker’s AI-powered text-to-speech solutions help publishers improve accessibility, engagement, and global reach.
- [Customizable TTS for Retail & Consumer Brands](https://www.readspeaker.com/sectors/retail/): Enhance retail and e-commerce with AI-powered text to speech. Create on-brand, accessible shopping and training experiences worldwide.
- [AI Voices for Transport Announcements (Airport, Train, Rail)](https://www.readspeaker.com/sectors/transportation/): Airport, bus or train, discover customizable AI voices for travel announcements and ticketing, enhancing clarity and customer experience across all channels.
- [AI Text to Speech for Workplace Training](https://www.readspeaker.com/sectors/workplace-training/): See how AI text to speech engages employees, provides inclusive training and improves learning outcomes.

- [Text-to-Speech (TTS) Solutions for any LMS](https://www.readspeaker.com/sectors/education/learning-management-systems/): Canvas, Brightspace, Blackboard, Moodle, and more. Make any LMS accessible with Readspeaker text to speech.

- [Text to Speech solution for Assess secure online testing and assessment platform](https://www.readspeaker.com/sectors/education/assess/): Add ReadSpeaker text to speech to the Assess secure online testing platform. Exam-ready TTS that meets ADA, SEND, and JCQ standards for fair, accessible assessments.

ReadSpeaker integrates in minutes, meets JCQ/WCAG, and delivers accessible exams for primary, secondary, higher-ed, and corporate learners.
